Name: (CP) (MMAP)Where Winds Meet Patio Furniture
Author: umganil
Description:
[b][center]——————————————————————————————————————————————————
First of all, I have to thank mushymato for his excellent code support! He wrote all the code for this release. Without him, this release would not be possible.
——————————————————————————————————————————————————[/center][/b]
[color=#c9daf8][size=4][u]
[/u][/size][/color][center][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=3]What improvements and features does this version have compared to the original version (ending number 34815)?[/size][/color][/b][color=#9fc5e8][size=4][b][/b][/size][/color][/center]                                                 *All tree-shaped furniture is marked with a passable canopy, under which you can place whatever you want. Furniture with an expanded canopy can also be used to store items. (Oh my god, you probably don't know how long I've been wanting this feature)
                                                    *There is walking space under the archway, wine shed and pine trees, where other furniture can be placed.
                                                    *Click on the wanted list to open the notice board。
[size=2]                                                    [/size]*This version has an English translation! (from mushymato, thanks again)
[center]


﻿[/center][center][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=3]What are the prerequisites for this version compared to the original version (ending with number 34815)?
[/size][/color][/b][/center]
                                                    *Requires MMAP from mushymato. (It works without it, but what's the point of downloading it then?）
                                                    *Requires smapi, CP (essential, I believe everyone has it)
                                                    *Happy Home Designer and Precise Furniture are still recommended. They can help you match tree-shaped furniture to make it more staggered.


[center][/center][center][/center]
